subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — OTEL and Prometheus exporter mappings

question: Should OpenClaw adopt these six AI-safety events as a core and plugin-visible telemetry contract?
rationale: The stack creates long-lived event names, trust semantics, SDK exports, operator metrics, and compatibility obligations; correctness review cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the taxonomy
options.body: Approve the six-event contract and require the stacked PRs to satisfy cross-exporter, producer, privacy, compatibility, and real-runtime proof gates.

options.title: Narrow existing diagnostics
options.body: Instrument concrete safety signals through current security and diagnostic contracts without adding a new public taxonomy.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Defer the stacked PRs until an owner defines the safety telemetry product and compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the taxonomy
recommendation.body: Approve the six-event contract and require the stacked PRs to satisfy cross-exporter, producer, privacy, compatibility, and real-runtime proof gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merger history and broad architecture ownership make this the best available owner for accepting or rejecting a new core/public diagnostics contract.
